name: work-lens
description: Summarizes each step of work into a one-line, collapsible, filterable entry: category, plan item, and a planned / new / fix marker.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Comma-separated work categories the summaries are sorted into.
categories.default: notes, backlog & artifacts, code, auditing, evaluating

neutralCategories.title: Neutral categories
neutralCategories.description: Comma-separated categories counted as neutral (gray): upkeep that adds no direct value. Fixes are negative (red); everything else is positive (green).

model.title: Model
model.description: Model that writes the summaries (each step is one small extra request, shown in /cost).

autoSummarize.title: Summarize automatically
autoSummarize.description: Off: nothing is sent until you run /worklog summarize.

collapseByDefault.title: Collapse steps by default
collapseByDefault.description: Fullscreen layout: a summarized step shows as its one-line header until you press it.

labelDetail.title: Label detail
labelDetail.description: grouped: one chip per label group (Needs you, Review, Purpose, Work); press one to open its labels. all: every label as its own chip, side by side, value (▲ positive, ■ neutral, ▼ negative) included: the layout before 0.5.1.

labelGroups.title: Groups shown
labelGroups.description: Comma-separated label groups drawn on rows, chips and /worklog lines: needs, review, purpose, work. Display only: what is sent to the model is unchanged (see judgeRules and sendFailureText).

outwardPatterns.title: Extra outward patterns
outwardPatterns.description: Comma-separated regular expressions over a parsed shell command; a match marks the step ⇪ outward (sent off this machine). Invalid ones are left out and logged.

judgeRules.title: Judge rule breaks and assumptions
judgeRules.description: Sends an excerpt of your standing rules (CLAUDE.md files, feedback memories, hook names) and your latest typed message with each summary, and asks for ⚑ deviation and ◇ assumption. Off: neither is sent or asked.

sendFailureText.title: Send failure text
sendFailureText.description: Sends the first 300 characters (redacted) of each failed call's error, so a summary can tell an expected failure from a real one. Off: only the call is named.

maxCalls.title: Summary calls per 24 hours
maxCalls.description: A rolling budget: at most this many model attempts (retries included) in any 24 hours. Steps that wait for it are summarized, newest first, as the oldest calls age out.

keepRecent.title: Steps listed one per row
keepRecent.description: The Work log pane and /worklog list this many of the newest steps; older ones fold into one line per 100 steps (press it, or /worklog block <n>, to see them). An open ⚠ or a waiting ❗ is always listed.
